reviews.finding: The accepted plan is an exact structural factorization: source order, literal kernels, iterator domains, common prefixes, and post-render replay are gated.
The committed fixture is synthetic and redistributable; the demo makes no finite-Gamma, DC conductivity, scientific-identity, or canonical claim.
The untrusted proposer is data-only, output size and candidate count are capped, IDs are safe for Wolfram comments, and the manifest/negative tests are present.

release_scope: Stage only README.md, demos/raw_compaction_loop/, and tests/test_raw_compaction_loop_demo.py. The unrelated scripts/run_c0_chain_demo.py is excluded.
known_limits: A real model is supplied externally through --proposer-cmd; the bundled fixture is deterministic and not an LLM.
The verifier is intentionally limited to the documented raw Sum/factor grammar.
STRUCTURAL_CERTIFIED is not an independent Wolfram/CAS equality proof.
